title: Om Narayan Tripathi v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Arindam Sinha and Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed of; clause 6.5 bill-correction application to be decided in four weeks.
headnote: A writ seeking a direction to decide a U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 clause 6.5 complaint for electricity-bill correction is disposed of on the licensee's statement that the application will be duly dealt with. The concerned authority is directed to decide the application within four weeks. The bill is not examined on merits.
facts: Om Narayan Tripathi filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking a direction to respondent no. 2 to decide his complaint referable to clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 for correction of his electricity bill. Counsel for the State and for respondent nos. 2 and 3 appeared. The licensee's counsel submitted that the application would be duly dealt with by the concerned authority and an order passed. No particulars of the disputed bill, meter, or consumption were recorded.

holding_units.holding: On a writ seeking a direction to decide a clause 6.5 complaint for electricity-bill correction, and on the licensee's statement that the application will be duly dealt with, the Court disposes of the petition directing respondent no. 2 to decide the application within four weeks. The bill is not adjudicated on merits.

not_decided.point: merits of the clause 6.5 bill-correction complaint
not_decided.note: Left to the licensee to decide within four weeks.
